data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month: 250 total, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. This supports $10,000 per person every month indefinitely if we maintain it. I intend to request 10 and invite everyone to do the same. If stock ever falls below 500, let's each cap requests at floor(stock/50) to preserve at least half.

I propose a renewable quota: each of us requests 10 tons this month, totaling 250 and leaving 250. That guarantees next month's stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome, yielding $10,000 each month indefinitely if maintained. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. Please state whether you support the 10-ton quota; requests above it risk everyone's future income.

I propose a 10-ton monthly cap per fisher. If all 25 follow it, total catch is 250 tons, each earns $10,000, and the remaining 250 guarantees restoration to 500 even under the weaker replenishment outcome. This maximizes equal catches while guaranteeing a full lake next month. I intend to request 10 tons if this plan gains broad support; please state whether you support it.

I propose 10 tons each this month. With 25 fishers, that leaves 250 tons, guaranteeing restoration to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this supports $10,000 per fisher every month indefinitely. Larger collective catches risk shrinking next month's stock or collapse. I intend to request 10 and ask everyone to make the same voluntary commitment; revealed catches can guide future coordination.
